description: You are an urban transit planner for the City of Bologna's public transportation authority (TPER). The Pasubio corridor has received complaints about insufficient bus service coverage in the northern section of the network. Your task is to redesign the bus service to improve coverage and frequency. Using the Bologna Pasubio SUMO scenario, you must: (1) Analyze the existing bus network by examining the bus stops and routes already defined in the scenario files at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_pasubio/. (2) Design and implement a new express bus line ('Line_Express_N') that connects the northern and southern parts of the network. This requires creating at least 4 new bus stops in the network using netedit or by editing the additional files directly, positioned on edges that currently lack bus stops. (3) Create the bus route XML defining at least 3 bus vehicles running on this new line with staggered departure times (headway of approximately 600 seconds / 10 minutes), each stopping at all your new stops plus at least 2 existing stops. (4) Add pedestrian demand: generate at least 50 person trips that use public transit (mode='public') using SUMO's tools or by manually creating person definitions in a route file. (5) Create a modified simulation configuration that includes your new bus stops, routes, and person trips, and run it to completion. (6) Export a service coverage analysis to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/transit_service_report.csv with columns: stop_id, stop_name_or_lane, is_new, line_served, boarding_count, alighting_count. (7) Write a brief service improvement summary to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/transit_redesign_summary.txt explaining what improvements were made and expected ridership impact. The scenario data is at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_pasubio/.
